pages.title: Collect the patterns
pages.text: A populated Blueprint shows the item it makes and the ingredients it needs. Keep useful patterns from your travels; a blank blueprint teaches no recipe.$(br2)Place $(item)Blueprint Storage$() directly against a Constructor or Auto Constructor. Any face works. Each storage block holds six blueprints.
This starter library uses ordinary crafting. Marble colors may be mixed. You do not need an existing library to make it.

pages.title: Load your library
pages.text: Open Blueprint Storage and double-click its displayed slots to transfer blueprints between it and your inventory.$(br2)Blueprints stay in the library after crafting. Add more adjacent storage blocks for more patterns.$(br2)If you use JEI, look up a Constructor recipe to see its blueprint, ingredients and full output.
